summary.en: Selected programmes include two new medicines in registration and the pending adjuvant giredestrant indication, alongside late-stage oncology, Alzheimer’s disease, inflammatory bowel disease and obesity candidates. Acquisitions and partnerships support immunology and cardiometabolic expansion.
summary.zh: 入选项目包括两款注册中的新药和待批的giredestrant辅助治疗适应症，以及后期肿瘤、阿尔茨海默病、炎症性肠病和肥胖候选药物。收购和合作支持免疫及心血管代谢领域的拓展。

counts.note: 22 October 2026 Roche Group pipeline, pages 3–4: Phase I 33 NMEs + 6 additional indications; Phase II 11 + 5; Phase III 13 + 22; US/EU registration 3 + 8. Values sum the company-published components, not the selected items, and are not unique-asset counts.

watch.en: Giredestrant plus everolimus was FDA-approved for ESR1-mutated advanced breast cancer on November 16, 2026; the separate adjuvant application has a November 30 target date.

watch.en: The 2027 outlook lists fenebrutinib approvals and afimkibart Phase 3 UC data; these remain forward-looking milestones.

gaps: Origins of giredestrant, fenebrutinib, vamikibart, divarasib and trontinemab were not explicitly established by the opened sources; origin is null.
No dated next milestone was verified for trontinemab, enicepatide or petrelintide; next is null. Phase 3 status is from the October 2026 pipeline, not the older Phase 2 releases.
The March 2026 petrelintide release and 2025 annual report published before 2026-06 are used only for mechanism and transaction history. Current stages and indications use October 2026 sources.

Counts combine company-published NME and additional-indication components. Individual assets can occupy several stages; these counts are not directly comparable with companies reporting unique molecules.
Divarasib remained Phase 3 at the pipeline cutoff despite positive results and a company-listed potential approval in 2027; no submitted application was verified.

The advanced-breast-cancer giredestrant programme is excluded following FDA approval on November 16, 2026; the pending adjuvant indication is retained. Vamikibart guidance is by July 2027, without a verified exact decision date.
